en: I fell on the stairs yesterday.
I didn't fall from the bike today.
Did you fall in the street yesterday?
You didn't fall from the chair.
You (f.) fell in the water, sister.
You (f.) didn't fall at the station.
My phone fell on the ground.
The glass didn't fall from the table.
Rain fell last night.
The rain didn't fall this week.
We both fell into the puddle.
We didn't fall from on top of the wall.
Did you all fall on the stairs?

lat: ntuma ma t7tush f had l-berka
en: You didn't fall into this puddle.
The glasses fell from the table.
The leaves didn't fall from the tree.
I always fall when I run fast.
I don't fall when I ride the horse.
You fall a lot on the road.

lat: nta ma katti7sh f had l-blasa
en: You don't fall in this place.
You (f.) fall when you play soccer here.
You (f.) don't fall from above.
He always falls from the chair.
The price of bread doesn't drop.
It rains a lot in Fes.
Rain doesn't fall in the summer.
We always fall in this hole.

ar: حنا ما كنطيحوش ملي كنتمشاو بشوية
en: We don't fall when we walk slowly.
You fall a lot in the sand.

lat: ntuma ma katti7ush mn fuq l-3awd
ar: نتوما ما كتطيحوش من فوق العود
en: You don't fall from above the horse.
The leaves fall in autumn always.
They don't fall when they run.
Watch out, I am going to fall from the chair.

lat: ana ma ghadish nti7 f l-berka
en: I am not going to fall into the puddle.
Be careful brother, you are going to fall.

lat: nta ma ghadish tti7 mn d-druj
ar: نتا ما غاديش تطيح من الدروج
en: You are not going to fall from the stairs.
You (f.) are going to fall from the bike.

lat: ma tkhafish, nti ma ghadish tti7i
ar: ما تخافيش نتي ما غاديش تطيحي
en: Don't be afraid, you (f.) are not going to fall.
The glass is going to fall from the table.

lat: t-tilifun ma ghadish yti7 mn jibi
ar: التليفون ما غاديش يطيح من جيبي
en: The phone is not going to fall from my pocket.
Rain is going to fall in the evening.
Rain is not going to fall tomorrow.
If we hurry, we are going to fall.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nti7u f had l-berka
ar: حنا ما غاديش نطيحو فهاد البركة
en: We are not going to fall into this puddle.
Watch out kids, you are going to fall.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tti7u mn l-7ayt
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تطيحو من الحيط
en: You are not going to fall from the wall.
The leaves are going to fall from the tree.

lat: huma ma ghadish yti7u mn l-3awd
ar: هما ما غاديش يطيحو من العود
en: They are not going to fall from the horse.
